description: Event Test Command - /event-test command cho admin test các event embeds (welcome, goodbye, giveaway-end, level-up) without triggering real events. Chỉ admin permissions.
steps: 1. Add /event-test command to utility module (d:\projects\code\src\modules\utility\entry_point.ts) since it's general testing utility.
2. Command structure: /event-test với 2 options: event (string choice: welcome|goodbye|giveaway-end|level-up required) và user (user option optional, defaults to command executor).

3. For 'welcome' event: Read current welcome config from data/welcome-config.json for the guild. If embedEnabled, show the configured welcome embed. If custom design exists in data/welcome-designs.json, use that. Otherwise show default welcome message. Target user = selected user or executor.
4. For 'goodbye' event: Same pattern as welcome but from goodbye config. Read data/goodbye-config.json (create structure if not exists) and data/welcome-designs.json's goodbye field.

5. For 'giveaway-end' event: Create fake giveaway end embed following giveaway-module's end embed pattern. Show winner announcement with fake prize 'Test Prize' and selected user as winner. Use Components V2 card with giveaway colors.

6. For 'level-up' event: Create level-up celebration embed showing user leveled up from level 4 to level 5 (fake data). Use Components V2 with celebratory colors and emojis (star, trophy from emojis.ts).
7. Add permission check: PermissionFlagsBits.Administrator required. Show error if user lacks permission.
8. All test embeds sent as ephemeral reply (MessageFlags.Ephemeral) only visible to command executor.
9. Add header to each test embed: '-# 🧪 TEST MODE - This is a test preview' to clearly indicate it's not real event.
10. Handle missing config gracefully: If welcome/goodbye config doesn't exist, show simple default 'Welcome {user}!' or 'Goodbye {user}!' message in Components V2 card.
11. Update utility module's metadata.json to include /event-test in slashCommands array.
